legal_force.quote: This bill would prohibit making a companion chatbot available to users under 18 years of age, unless the chatbot is not foreseeably capable of certain actions.

summary.quote: This bill would prohibit making a companion chatbot available to users under 18 years of age, unless the chatbot is not foreseeably capable of certain actions.
Establishes the Leading Ethical AI Development (LEAD) for Kids Act, which regulates “covered products.”

A companion chatbot that can foreseeably do any of the following: i. Attempt to provide mental health therapy to the child. ii. Cause the child to develop a harmful ongoing emotional attachment to the companion chatbot.
Manipulate the child to engage in harmful behavior that results in legally cognizable harms.
Generate a social score for a child.
